senses.gloss:
Adma-sad. — This expression (lit. ‘sitting at the meal’), found
several times in the Rigveda,^1 is usually rendered ‘guest at the
feast,’ but Geldner^2 adduces reasons to show that it means ‘a
fly,’ so called because of its settling on food.
1) i. 124, 4; vi. 30, 3; vii. 83, 7;
viii. 44, 29; adma-sadvan, vi. 4, 4.
2) Vedische Studien, 2, 179, 180; but
of Oldenberg, Vedaforschung, 90.
